messages:
alex: Heads up — discovered a sparse shard pattern for hourly telemetry yesterday, ~12% of hours missing across some tenant cohorts.
maria: where are missing hours showing up? eu or us?
ethan: mostly eu-A / shard-47, and a scatter in us-west on low-traffic tenants. looks like partial ingest lag + dedupe TTL.
jamal: are these "missing" or just late-arriving? can we use replay window?
alex: late vs missing mixed. some events are delayed by Kafka lag, some were dropped by dedupe bug (fixed last week). Need targeted refill for <=72h window. not full recompute.
maria: can we route these to the small-batch backfill queue? we have quota for low-impact fills.
ethan: routing + dedupe is tricky: if we run normal replay it'll double-count unless we mark tombstones. proposal: use aggregation-only path that ignores raw upserts and replays only aggregated deltas.
jamal: that needs an API change. agg-only path doesn't exist today. alternative: run normal replay with idempotency token per shard+hour.
console-ui: if we do that, need a progress bar on console for "sparse-fill" with expected token counts and estimated cost.
alex: cost est from sim: ~0.16 core-hours per hour filled for shard-47. For 2k hours that's ~320 core-hours.
maria: ok to use quota if we tag as "sparse-fill" and soft-limit to 50 core-hours/day.
ethan: technical note — idempotency per shard+hour is easiest but requires replay controller to accept header X-Replay-Idempotency: <uuid>. Quick patch exists in PR #2234.
jamal: prefer agg-only to avoid downstream noise; but ok take idempotency as interim.
alex: ops: can you add a routing policy? route sparse-fill to dedicated small-batch pool, with capacity=2 workers, priority=low.
sre-bot: Deploy scheduled at 11:30 PST: update routing policy small-batch pool -> applied. :white_check_mark: 
maria: added console flag: "sparse_backfill_mode" to toggle agg-only when released.
ethan: PR merged and canary at 10% — rolling watch on related metrics: telemetry.fill.success, telemetry.fill.dup_rate
alex: I'll kick off a pilot for shard-47 first and post results here. tagging @jamal @maria
jamal: ack. ping if dup_rate > 1%.
alex: run command:
```
./backfill_ctl start --shard=47 --hours=200 --mode=agged --tag=sparse_fill_2024-12-01
```
alex: starting now, will update with first 10-hour summary in ~30m.
maria: thanks — adding a dashboard panel: query = `sum(telemetry.fill.hours_processed) by (shard)` and `rate(telemetry.fill.dup_rate[5m])`
ethan: FYI I'll add a post-run sanity check that compares aggregate counts to the last-good snapshot to ensure no regressions.
alex: perfect.
